messages:
emma: Quick thread to decide algorithm + launch scope for "fair spill" behavior across reserved pools. Key asks from PM/Customers: deterministic spill ordering during simultaneous bursts, predictable cost model, and no noisy-neighbor regressions.

vikram: We have two strong candidates: waterfilling (proportional fill until cap) vs FIFO (longest-burst-first). Waterfilling is fairer by weight but harder to reason about billing.

olivia: Ops note: waterfilling reduces tail latency variance but requires per-tenant rate tracking and more state in the broker. That complicates GC/scale.

carmen: From product/customer POV: they want a simple guarantee: if I reserve X, I get X baseline; if others burst, my ingress shouldn't drop below Y% for short windows. They also asked for clear billing: overflow billed as either prorated-reserved or overflow-discount.

emma: Proposal: implement waterfilling as default fairness algorithm for simultaneous bursts, with a config flag to switch to FIFO for customers who prefer predictable ordering. Also introduce a smoothing window to avoid oscillations: smoothing_ms = 5000 by default.

vikram: Proto sketch for runtime config (for eng-runtime + ops sim):

```
spill_policy {
  algorithm: WATERFILLING  // WATERFILLING | FIFO
  tenant_weights_source: "reservation_size" // or explicit weight
  smoothing_window_ms: 5000
  protected_soft_window_s: 30
  per_tenant_protection: OPTIONAL  // FREE | PAID
  billing_mode: PRORATED_RESERVED // RESERVED_RATE | HOSTED_OVERFLOW | DISCOUNTED_OVERFLOW
}
```

olivia: Important: autoscaler needs synthetic burst templates so it doesn't prewarm unnecessarily. Can analytics generate 95/99 burst overlap frequency for pilot tenants? @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: Job `burst_overlap_frequency_v1` created for tenants tagged `fair-spill-pilot`. Daily summary will post to #eng-runtime. Also added a synthetic-load job template `sim-burst-1m` for canary runs.

carmen: Launch criteria suggestion: (1) unit + integration tests validating fairness (waterfill invariants) and preempt ordering, (2) canary in APAC with 4 pilot tenants for 10 days, (3) dashboards for per-tenant allocation, spill_tokens, latency_p95/p99, and billing_delta, (4) runbook with manual revert & per-tenant override.

emma: Ops requests: add a hard cap TTL if smoothing window is exceeded (e.g., if tenant is in soft_window > 2x configured seconds then escalate to preempt). Also need an emergency fair-evict flow based on weighted_least_recently_served. Add to runbook.

vikram: Billing decision: ship GA with billing_mode default = PRORATED_RESERVED but enforcement behind feature flag. Rationale: keeps sales simple and avoids surprise. Document the policy and expose toggle.

olivia: Testing notes: add a multi-tenant simultaneous burst test with randomized weights to catch edge cases and ensure no tenant starves. Also add perf test for the broker state size.

carmen: Customer-facing language: "During short bursts we apply a fairness policy to allocate reserved and overflow capacity. Overflow may be routed to hosted backfill; billing will default to your reserved rate during pilot and switch to overflow billing once enabled with notice." Will draft FAQ.

emma: Action items: vikram = implement proto + unit tests, olivia = autoscale sim + canary harness, carmen = customer FAQ + pricing note, emma = runbook + SLA wording + sign-off. Book 30m alignment Thurs. If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll lock scope to waterfilling default with billing behind feature flag. :thumbsup:

vikram: I'll also add a telemetry invariant check that'll alert if waterfill allocations differ from simulated expectations by >10%.

olivia: Ops request: include a soft-billing-cap for pilots so customers can't accidentally run a massive hosted bill if billing_mode flips later.

emma: Good call. We'll add a pilot soft-cap and alerting. Final note: keep runtime switch cheap (feature flag + config change) so we can A/B test algorithm in prod.

carmen: I'll circulate the customer-facing blurb + pricing strawman today. Thanks all.
